whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Flex Studio,

I noticed your gym has stellar 4.7★ reviews with 220+ happy members in Ashiana-Digha Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for instant membership inquiries and batch timings.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur trainer profiles integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://flexstudio.arclanestudios.space

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
"Hi Team Flex Studio, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke gym (Flex Studio) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. 

Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? 

Great! We tailored it specifically with high-speed mobile booking, direct WhatsApp trial requests, and your 4.7★ rating highlight right in Ashiana-Digha Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? 

Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur schedule integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
